kind: Calculated Standard-mode API-equivalent token cost; not actual billed charge
rate_source: User-supplied screenshot; checked against official model documentation

long_context_policy.condition: Applied per request, not cumulative task input.

sessions.cache_write_counter_basis: Ending cumulative cache_write_input_tokens is zero; first cumulative usage equals first-call usage, establishing zero counter origin.
Ending cumulative cache_write_input_tokens is zero; first cumulative usage equals first-call usage, establishing zero counter origin.

scope: Original Task A primary and reviewer turns, including final responses. All follow-up/publishing turns excluded.
formula: (input_tokens - cached_input_tokens) * 2 / 1000000 + cached_input_tokens * 0.10 / 1000000 + output_tokens * 10 / 1000000. Cache-write charge is zero because recorded writes are zero.
assumptions: Standard-mode rates requested by user; no Fast/Ultrafast, regional or other billing modifiers applied.
Reasoning output is included within output; cached input is included within input. Neither is added twice.
No request exceeds the long-context threshold.
Subscription fees, tool/service fees, tax, and other invoice-specific adjustments are outside this token-only estimate.
